caption.en: Warm amber, verdigris, and violet tones swirl through sculpted glass fur as a curious kitten rests one translucent paw over a frosted ledge.
caption.zh: 暖琥珀、孔雀綠與紫韻在琉璃毛紋間流動，小貓將透明前爪搭在霧面玻璃檯緣好奇凝望。

alt.en: Iridescent amber, teal, and violet glass tabby kitten resting one paw over a frosted glass ledge
alt.zh: 將琥珀色透明前爪搭在霧面玻璃邊緣的彩韻琉璃虎斑小貓雕塑
